title: ARKADE
networkCaption:
Choose Arkade network and optional custom ASP.
Confirm to save and restart the app.
aspEmptyHint: Leave empty to use the official server for this network.
networkHint:
Each network has its own wallets and encrypted local DB.
Switching does not move funds between networks.
invalidServerBody: Enter a valid http(s) ASP URL.
delegatesCaption:
A delegate helps renew expiring VTXOs.
Default is the Arkade network delegator.
